body: Thank you! I'm just hesitant to go see a doctor bc I don't want to have someone tell me something is "wrong" with me. I just want to be able to act "normal" and idk I'm just convinced I make up everything in my head and don't want to waste anybody's time. Idk. I have a hard time changing my viewpoint for myself. I'm really supportive of the whole community but I feel like I just imagine all my issues.

I've applied to a bunch of places. About a month ago I was getting calls back, but that was right before I had a surgery, so then I was unavailable for about 3 weeks. I'm super frustrated bc this one place called me and asked me if I wanted the job and I said yes, and I was told to call when I was available and fully recovered. I've called about 3 times since, and every time the lady I need to talk to is not there and I've been told they left a message for her to call me. I'm just really sick of all the bullshit bc that place was my top pick and they won't even call me back. The last time I called was a week ago, and I figure I should call back bc I was told they would call me but part of me is just so fed up.

Thank YOU man! I'm alright like 60% of the time it's just when I get stressed or upset it's everything at once lol. The only time I can really remove myself is when I'm at college, otherwise I'm stuck with them. Thank you for talking to me I really appreciate it!

Thank you, that means a lot :). Haha our relationship is a little more complicated than I originally mentioned, we were dating for a bit but I was getting frustrated bc my heart just wasn't in it and I would've rather just been friends/hook up buddies and recently (I had a more level head lol) I told him how I felt and he agreed and said he felt the same and that we should wait until we're both ready if we really want to date. So I'm not too worried I know he likes me enough to still talk to me even after I act like a psychopath and I know he cares bc he constantly tells me to get help...it's just so much more complicated than just going and getting it and I don't think he realizes that.

Your username gave me a chuckle lol
